resources.string: Remote could not complete this action. See the error details.
Could not confirm that the message was sent.
Codex did not accept this message. Check the error details before trying again.
Agora could not access local Remote storage. Check available space.
Cannot reach Filo. Check the target computer, service address and network.
Filo could not authenticate this request. This does not necessarily mean the access token is wrong. If it persists, check the target computer’s token and clock.
Enter a valid service URL and a 64-character access token.
Agora could not verify or read the Filo response. Check that both apps are up to date.
Codex could not complete the request.
Agora could not save this device. Check available storage and save again.
Another Codex process owns this conversation. Wait for it to release the conversation.
The response or attachment exceeds the supported size.
Filo could not read this request. Check the supplied values.
The requested item is no longer available. Refresh the list.
This source does not support this action.
Filo cannot reach Codex Desktop. Open Codex on the target computer.
Codex has not made this conversation ready. Check it on the target computer.
Filo cannot reach its user helper. Check the Filo service on the target computer.
The Codex Desktop runtime is unavailable. Open Codex to finish its setup.
Filo is shutting down. Wait for the service to become available.
The request timed out. Check the conversation before sending again.
The active response changed. Refresh the conversation before trying the operation again.
This image is unavailable on the target computer.
The attachment upload is incomplete or invalid. Select the file again.
Filo cannot store the attachment. Check storage on the target computer.
Filo is handling too many requests. Wait a moment.
Codex usage information is currently unavailable.
Codex does not support the selected setting for this model.
